operations.details: Verified official OGC CoverageJSON standard page.
CoverageJSON encoding separated from measurement accuracy and raster lineage.
Gridded payload structure not promoted to native survey resolution.
Coverage values require independent datum, source date and uncertainty evidence.
Verified official OGC GML standard page.
GML schema validity separated from coordinate or legal-boundary precision.
GML feature structure not promoted to exact HMLR parcel boundary evidence.
GML coordinate/value transport not treated as terrain observation accuracy.
CoverageJSON and GML URLs distinct from prior source registry.
No encoded value or feature structure substituted for official parcel results.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
